eligibility: Be 18 years of age or older by Dec. 7, 2026
Be available for a full-time internship (30 hours per week)
Be willing to quit a full-time job
must be able to work 30 hours per week
cannot_apply_if: You cannot apply if you are not available for a full-time internship
You cannot apply if you are a past Outreachy intern.
You cannot apply if you are a past Outreach Program for Women intern.
You cannot apply if you are a past Google Summer of Code intern.
You cannot apply if you have another internship during the Outreachy internship period.
You cannot apply if you have a full-time job
You cannot apply if you have a full-time contracting position
You cannot apply if you are on a leave of absence from a full-time job
You cannot apply if you are not a student
You cannot apply if you cannot work 30 hours per week
prepare: Have a calendar for online courses (online courses)
Have a calendar for coding school (coding school)
Have the average number of invoiced hours over the past six months (self-employed contractor)
Write answers to five essay questions (essays)
